//: Generic template — copy to config.json and fill in. Keys starting with // are ignored by the loader and exist purely as inline docs.

profile.//: Personal identity — populates apply_assistant.html's copy-to-clipboard panel.
profile.visa_status: <e.g. Citizen | Permanent Resident | Work Visa Required>

scraper.//search_locations: Cities or regions to inject into Google search queries. Add 'Remote' if applicable.
scraper.//target_titles: Job-title keywords (lowercase, substring match) → score weight. Higher = more relevant to you.
scraper.//strict_filter_titles: Titles in this list get EXTRA gates from `strict_rules` (e.g. required keywords in desc + YoE cap). Leave empty to disable strict filtering.
scraper.//exclude_companies: Hard reject these companies (case-insensitive substring match against company name).
scraper.//exclude_title_words: Hard reject any title containing these substrings (intern, junior, director, …).
scraper.//exclude_desc_keywords: Hard reject if posting description contains any of these. E.g. ['clearance'] for non-citizens.
scraper.//tech_keywords: Skills / tools that boost relevance (+3 each, capped at +25). For non-tech roles use whatever industry-specific keywords apply (e.g. 'figma', 'a/b testing', 'crm').
scraper.//min_score: Minimum relevance score (0-100) to include a job in results. Lower to see more, raise to be picky.
scraper.//max_posting_age_days: Drop jobs older than this many days where the ATS exposes a posting date.
scraper.//query_templates: Google search templates used during slug discovery. {site} = ATS host, {location} = each search_location.
scraper.//locations: Geographic scoring. preferred_area = top priority (kw → +pts), allowed = secondary, exclude_regions = reject if posting location contains any of these substrings, exclude_remote_regions = reject 'remote' postings whose location says one of these.
scraper.//strict_rules: Applied ONLY to titles in strict_filter_titles. require_keywords_in_desc: ALL must appear; max_years_experience: drop if posting says '>N years'. Set max_years_experience to 0 to disable.
